A powerful opponent has re-emerged from the Ley Lines, and the battle is sure to be very difficult
Affected by the Ley Line Disturbance, characters cannot be deployed multiple times
You have reached the final defensive line of the Domain. The level of disturbance here is at its highest, interfering with even the Exalted Ones and rendering their Eminent Boons ineffective. traits.name: Courage Against the Cold: Hearty Draught
traits.desc: Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, this Nemesis will periodically take out a flask and drink deeply, gaining a large amount of Courage in the process. If it is affected by Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while drinking, it will gain Courage at a reduced rate. Dealing Electro DMG to it will also reduce its Courage. Electro DMG considered to be DMG from the corresponding Stellar Glimmer Reaction will reduce Courage by a significantly greater amount.

traits.name: Valiant Assault
traits.desc: Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, once the Nemesis's Courage is full, they will enter the Valiant Assault state. While in this state, their attacks will become more ferocious. They will also generate a shield and greatly increase all Elemental and Physical RES other than Electro RES, which will receive a small increase.. While Valiant Assault is active, the Nemesis's Courage will be continuously consumed. Electro DMG will also drain more Courage than usual. It will exit this state and suffer massive backlash DMG once its Courage is depleted. The more DMG its shield absorbs during Valiant Assault, the greater the backlash DMG it will suffer when the state ends. Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG will increase the backlash DMG taken when the Shield is broken.

traits.name: Molten Crown
traits.desc: The twin molten horns located high up on the body of the Emperor of Fire and Iron are Pyro-aligned organs that enable it to unleash more vicious elemental attacks and grant it even stronger defensive capabilities. When unleashing certain attacks, its twin molten horns will stay close to the ground, providing an opportunity to use Elemental Reactions to destroy them. Once the Pyro element stored within the twin molten horns is exhausted, they will be destroyed, causing the powerful foe to take a single instance of immense DMG. Once destroyed, the horns cannot be restored for a period of time.

traits.name: Shield Bearers
traits.desc: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, the Emperor of Fire and Iron will summon Sternshield Crabs to assist during battle. Sternshield Crabs continuously channel Pyro to the twin molten horns. Once their Pyro is exhausted, the Sternshield Crabs will be defeated. Once a Sternshield Crab is defeated, it will lose control and collide with the Emperor of Fire and Iron, overloading the Pyro element within its twin molten horns and damaging them, causing the Emperor of Fire and Iron to take DMG proportional to the DMG the Sternshield Crab itself has received. A maximum of three Sternshield Crabs can be on the field at once.

traits.name: Radiant Coronation
traits.desc: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, the Emperor of Fire and Iron will perform Radiant Coronation in battle, charging briefly before dealing DMG over a large AoE. Destroy the twin molten horns to interrupt its charging.

parts.note: Advantage: Geo Characters or Healing Characters

traits.name: Vagrant Reverberation
traits.desc: After the battle begins, the Nemesis leaves a Moonstone Anchor in its place before leaping to higher ground to prepare for Vagrant Reverberation. Some time later, it unleashes a large and powerful AoE strike. Use methods suited to dealing with Geo to break through the multiple Geo ward layers on the Moonstone Anchor. Destroying it interrupts the skill's charge-up and deals massive DMG to the Nemesis. The more DMG the Moonstone Anchor takes during the preparation phase, the greater the DMG dealt to the Nemesis when the Moonstone Anchor is destroyed. Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, using Geo attacks against the Moonstone Anchor further increases the DMG dealt to the Nemesis.

traits.name: Unshakable Rock
traits.desc: Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, the Moonstone Anchor's multi-layered Geo Ward becomes more resilient.

traits.name: Radiant Cocoon
traits.desc: During battle, the Nemesis harnesses Geo to apply Radiant Cocoon to characters and increase its own Geo RES. Characters afflicted by Radiant Cocoon deal less DMG and receive less healing. When a character's HP is restored to full through healing, they break free from the cocoon and gain the Disentangled effect, which boosts their abilities for a short time. Once any character in the party successfully breaks free, the Nemesis loses the Geo RES granted by Radiant Cocoon.|}

traits.desc: When a Boss enemy is attacked, the attack's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 10%.

Each time a Boss enemy enters an Attribute Anomaly state, it gains 1 stack of Afterglow Mark. When it reaches 3 stacks, all Afterglow Marks are consumed, and the Boss enters the Wax Wings state for 30 seconds.
While in the Wax Wings state, the Boss takes 30% increased Attribute Anomaly DMG and accumulates an additional 5% Daze when entering an Attribute Anomaly state, but no longer gains Afterglow Marks.
When the Boss is Stunned, it immediately enters the Wax Wings state. If it is already in the Wax Wings state, the duration is reset.
Each successful against an enemy attack grants an additional 1,000 Performance Points;

After an enemy deploys a Spatial Barrier, each successful stomp on a golden area that triggers a Defensive Assist grants an additional 1,500 Performance Points; up to 5,000 Performance Points can be earned this way.

After Infernal Revenant enters the Infernal state, the Attribute Anomaly DMG it takes is reduced by 30%; every time is triggered, the Boss gains 1 stack of Overheat; triggering Defensive Assist or Perfect Dodge 2 times in total applies 1 stack of Overheat on the Boss, and each stack of Overheat increases CRIT DMG of the whole squad by 25%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 20s. Triggering Defensive Assist or retriggering Overheat resets the duration.
Successfully triggering Shutdown grants 2000 Performance Points; each flint shattered grants 1000 Performance Points, up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points.

Agents inflict Overwhelmed when landing a Defensive Assist hit against a Boss enemy, and 3 stacks of Overwhelmed when accumulating 3 Defensive Assist hits and triggering Impaired. Each stack of Overwhelmed increases Daze by 15%, and Chain Attack and Ultimate DMG taken while Stunned by 10%. The enemy will fix the impaired parts and reset the impairment level while charging, and will reset its Overwhelmed stacks after recovering from Stun.
Assist Points are not consumed for this battle.
Successfully triggering a Perfect Assist grants 300 Performance Points.
Successfully causing Impaired grants 900 Performance Points. A maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be obtained.

After Shutdown against a Boss enemy's Control Skill, Daze dealt by the whole squad's Agents increases by 15%, DEF increases by 30%, and when their attacks hit enemies, CRIT DMG increases by 75%, and Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 15%.
While the Boss is Stunned, Sharp DMG dealt by the whole squad's Agents increases by 60%, Wind and Ice CRIT DMG dealt increases by 80% and ignores 40% of the Boss's DEF.

Each time you successfully neutralize the boss's attacks and trigger the boss's special stagger, it grants 1,000 Performance Points. During the , each successful counter against the Boss's attacks grants 500 Performance Points. Performing a Shutdown on the Boss's Control Skill grants 2,000 Performance Points. During the , when triggering Shutdown via , obtain the remaining Performance Points available from the current Control Skill. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.
